purpose: Score ACTUAL capability, not repo completeness. Every point traces to evidence with a level; evidence decays with time; comparators are scored on the same rubric from their public record (plus our hands-on evaluation where marked).

evidence_levels.3: live-verified — re-runnable command against a live target, record included
evidence_levels.2: corpus-verified — replayable solver + accepted answer in the recorded corpus
evidence_levels.1: doc-claimed — stated by the project's own docs, no independent verification

decay.policy: live evidence loses one level per decay_days without re-verification; corpus evidence decays at half rate (targets change slower than gates); doc claims never decay below 1

invalidation: an evidence entry may carry "invalidated": true with a note — it scores 0 but STAYS listed (negative results are part of the truth)

dimensions.what: independent real targets solved end-to-end, weighted by difficulty tier (1=basic … 4=triple-layer vm/wasm)
zero-browser delivery ratio among solved targets
anti-gate families cleared with re-runnable evidence (CF L0-L3b ladder, captcha families); an entry marked `partial` (e.g. handshake proven on a TEST sitekey only) counts as half a family
documented misdiagnosis patterns, each with a cheap disproof test; extra for gym-encodable
capability regression: synthetic challenges solved blind by ONE generic recipe tree (not per-flavor code)
% of capability claims that are re-runnable; honest gaps recorded; negative results published
release gates, leak scans, link integrity, atomic push
evaluated-vs-absorbed external tools (incl. honest rejections) + dependency health checks
stars / forks / external contributions — adoption is NOT capability; weight says so
last release recency + last live verification recency + maintenance status
